anti_scalp_reason_mapping.NO_HTF_CONTEXT: Nonterminal diagnostic tag only; inherited WAIT stays WAIT. Excluded from Anti-Scalp rejected-plan/case denominator. Count distinct waiting origins separately, never add retries or WAIT origins to rejected total.
anti_scalp_reason_mapping.POOR_EDGE_COST_RATIO: N2_s<K_s; retain REJECT_INSUFFICIENT_STRUCTURAL_PAYOFF as detailed native reason
anti_scalp_reason_mapping.TARGET_TOO_CLOSE: inward target collapses into/non-forward E after selection; no farther fallback
anti_scalp_reason_mapping.edge_cost_ratio: d*(T_s-E_s)/[0.0008*(E_s+T_s)] base round-trip fees+slippage; doubled_ratio uses 0.0016; finite positive costs
anti_scalp_reason_mapping.exclusive_counts: one primary scalp reason per rejected plan; context WAIT counts separate, do not double-count retries as unique cases
anti_scalp_reason_mapping.rejected_total: Only terminal economic/geometry rejection flags count; nonterminal NO_HTF_CONTEXT has terminal_rejection=false and is reported in separate waiting_origins_NO_HTF_CONTEXT statistic.
anti_scalp_reason_mapping.status: REJECTED_SCALP_RISK for pre-entry scalp-risk rejection; preserve lifecycle WAIT/retire primary reasons separately

outcome_isolation.decision_stream: contains pre-entry fields only; future candle/funding/outcome values forbidden
outcome_isolation.execution_stream: FILL/EXIT/EOF_CENSOR event IDs/timing may be appended only after observation, no performance/PnL/WIN/LOSS and never fed into decisions
outcome_isolation.no_duration_feature: holding bounds may appear only in future post-run statistics, never admission
outcome_isolation.observer_interface: write-only append-only sink; exception cannot become a signal filter; failed evidence persistence is an integrity STOP, not a different strategy selection
outcome_isolation.required_anti_scalp_statistics: counts by primary rejection reason and gross/cost/net/holding diagnostics in a later authorized run, never a feature for this design gate

reason_code_contract.FIRST_EVAL: one record per formation/gate before first status; paired PASS/WAIT/REJECT possible at same cutoff
reason_code_contract.PASS: first_pass_at fixed at first PASS; later passes separately recorded without changing first
reason_code_contract.WAIT: one status per gate evaluation at cutoff; retry_count counts WAIT evaluations, not origins
reason_code_contract.context_id: nullable before context evaluated; never invented
reason_code_contract.terminal: REJECT/RETIRE/EOF occurs once per origin; no later admission for that identity
